content.comment_body: [product_name] [version_no] Service Pack 1 is now available as a Microsoft Excel Add-In, allowing users to read archived data from [product_name] devices while they are in RUN mode. • Download ([article_no] MB)

analysis.insight_summary: This post presents the release of Service Pack 1 for [product_name] [version_no], a Microsoft Excel Add-In created to enable archive data reading from [product_name] devices during operation. It is informative, without user issues or support requests.
